name: Mental Health Clinic of Mbale RRH
description: It provides psychiatric and mental health services including screening, diagnosis, management of mental illness, and substance use disorders. The clinic supports various patient groups, including youth, elderly, and people with alcohol/drug-related mental illnesses.
services: Management of mental illnesses including drug and alcohol abuse disorders
Inpatient and outpatient mental health care.

name: UYAHF Adolescent health Clinic
description: UYAHF Adolescent Health Clinic is a community-based medical center focused on providing quality, integrated, and comprehensive health care and Sexual and Gender-Based Violence (SGBV) services that are adolescent-responsive and human rights-centered.
services: Screening and treatment for all STIs

name: StrongMinds Uganda Mbale
description: StrongMinds Uganda Mbale is part of StrongMinds' broader work in Uganda that focuses on providing community-based group therapy to treat depression, primarily targeting adult women and adolescents.
services: Rapid response mental health support to communities
Community-led group therapy sessions that provide emotional support and promote resilience
Support for trauma linked to environmental stressors and social challenges

name: Uganda Counselling Association
description: Uganda Counselling Association (UCA) is Uganda’s national professional body for counsellors and psychotherapists, established in 2002. It aims to advance the counseling profession through advocacy, education, training, research, and professional regulation.
services: Advocacy for policies to improve access to counseling and mental health services
Consultancy services for organizations needing counseling expertise

name: MILAALA HEALTH NET FOUNDATION
description: MILAALA HEALTH NET FOUNDATION (MiHEF) is an organization based in Uganda committed to advancing mental health and psychosocial wellness.

name: Butabika National Referral Mental Hospital
description: Uganda's only national referral hospital specializing in mental health, with a capacity of 550 beds.
services: Psychiatric assessment and treatment; management of mental illnesses including drug and alcohol abuse disorders; inpatient and outpatient mental health care; medication-assisted therapy; crisis intervention and counseling services.

name: China Uganda Friendship Hospital
description: It provides psychiatric and mental health services including screening, diagnosis, management of mental illness, and substance use disorders. The clinic supports various patient groups, including youth, elderly, and people with alcohol/drug-related mental illnesses.
services: Psychiatric assessment and treatment; management of mental illnesses including drug and alcohol abuse disorders; inpatient and outpatient mental health care; medication-assisted therapy; crisis intervention and counseling services.

name: Hope and Beyond Alcohol and Drugs Treatment
description: Hope and Beyond Alcohol and Drugs Treatment is a well-established organization based in Uganda, with over 13 years of impact in addiction treatment, mental health promotion, and community support.
services: including psychological and organ function tests
Multi-disciplinary rehabilitation with individualized care plans and counseling
Long-term recovery care through addiction competence center facilities

name: Free Hearts Uganda
description: Free Hearts Uganda is a substance abuse treatment and rehabilitation center, likely the first half-way house in Uganda specializing in addiction recovery services. They focus on treating alcoholism, marijuana, heroin, cocaine, and other substance abuses.
services: Substance abuse treatment and rehabilitation (alcoholism, marijuana, heroin, cocaine) including addiction recovery

name: The Rehab Clinic
description: A leading rehabilitation service provider offering a comprehensive range of therapies including physiotherapy, occupational therapy, mental health services, speech therapy, and nutrition support.

name: Epignosis Rehabilitation
description: Epignosis Rehabilitation is a center committed to transforming lives by addressing addiction through resolving underlying issues such as trauma, personal struggles, and psychological blind spots.

name: Reclaim Health Rehabilitation Center
description: A private, exclusive rehabilitation center with a focus on recovery from addictions, eating disorders, and mental health challenges.
services: Addiction recovery including complete in-house detox programs
Holistic care addressing physical, emotional and mental aspects
Tailored therapy and supportive recovery environment

name: Serenity Center Uganda
description: Serenity Centre Uganda is a treatment and rehabilitation facility for individuals affected by alcohol and substance abuse.
services: Treatment and rehabilitation for alcohol and substance abuse
Prevention and treatment services for individuals
Support for income-generating activities for recovering women

name: Makerere University Counseling Center
description: Counselling and Guidance Centre at Makerere University helps students and staff address personal, emotional, academic, and psychological challenges that affect their wellbeing and productivity.
services: Outreach programs to residences and hostels
Seminars and workshops for students and staff
Staff support and consultations on welfare and development issues

name: Kyambogo university Guidance and Counselling Centre
description: It offers free and confidential counselling services aimed at supporting students, staff, parents, and the wider community to handle personal or psychological challenges that may impact academic performance or work at the university.
services: Outreach programs to halls of residence and hostels
Mentoring work scheme students and counsellor trainees
Crisis counselling support for staff and students

name: Gender Mainstreaming Directorate, Makerere University
description: GMD acts as the Secretariat for the Gender Mainstreaming Programme, promoting gender equality and women's empowerment within the university.
services: Institutionalizing gender mainstreaming in core and support functions of the university
Promoting gender balance in recruitment and student enrollment
Leading affirmative action programs such as tuition waivers for female students from disadvantaged backgrounds
Acting as a resource and advisory body on gender issues within the university

name: Naguru Teenage Information and Health Center
description: NTIHC is a pioneering adolescent sexual and reproductive health center in Uganda. It provides youth-friendly, responsive Adolescent Sexual and Reproductive Health (ASRH) services primarily for young people aged 10-24 years.
services: General counseling and referrals for youth (10-24 years)
Mental health and substance use prevention

name: CHILD RESTORATION OUTREACH (CRO)
description: It focuses on holistic support including education, counseling, family reunification, and livelihood improvement to improve the welfare of street children.

name: East Africa Centre For Addiction Services- EACAS
